newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Telekom to comment on 96 earnings in Mar.
newsitem.headline: D.Telekom to comment on 96 earnings in Mar.

text.p: German telecommunications group Deutsche Telekom AG said on Monday it would make a general statement about its 1996 earnings and an outlook for 1997 at the Cebit information technology fair in March.

The company made the comment after coming under fire from analysts who complained that it had provided no new information about its business since just before its initial public offering of shares in November.
The company will detail 1996 results at a news conference on May 13, but until now has given no clear indication that it would provide any information about its 1996 earnings before that date.
